blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Joel Villanueva is pushing for the creation of an unemployment insurance program as he cited concerns over rising unemployment and “stagflation” in the country. During the Senate deliberations on the Department of Social Welfare and Development’s (DSWD) proposed 2027 budget on Wednesday, Villanueva asked whether the agency has programs to assist workers who have lost their jobs. “When it comes to employees who were fired or nawalan ng trabaho, ano po ang programa ng DSWD when it comes to helping them?” asked Villanueva, chair of the Senate committee on labor, employment and human resources development.
